_purpose: Pre-holdout architecture freeze manifest, V7 -- supersedes V6. V1-V6 all preserved unmodified for chronology.

lineage.reason: predicate semantics + third scope case + CandidateClaim doc -- no code changes
taxonomy #23 -- honest hedge against EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED/REVOKED/FUTURE_EFFECTIVE was flagged unconditionally

taxonomy #24 -- order-dependent `chosen` selection when no document is CURRENT among multiple non-current candidates; not a governance-correctness bug (observable gate behavior was already robust to it) but a real non-determinism in a system whose premise is deterministic state resolution, found while constructing LNES59-B17-001

why_a_v7_freeze_was_needed: Taxonomy #24: classify_document now returns each match's effective date; _resolve_predicate_group's fallback (when no candidate is CURRENT) picks the most recently effective candidate instead of the list-order-dependent first entry. Verified order-independent across three different orderings of the same grounding set.

explicitly_not_frozen.cases*.json / documents*.json: dataset content -- documents_batch17.json/cases_batch17.json are Phase 5 tranche 14 (1 new DEVELOPMENT case), more tranches follow toward 100
explicitly_not_frozen.test_*.py: test files grow with the dataset and with each red-team pass

gate._version_note: Unchanged since V6 -- taxonomy #24 was extraction-layer only.

extraction._version_note: 1.5 = V6. 1.6 = this freeze -- classify_document returns _effective_date; _resolve_predicate_group's no-CURRENT-candidate fallback is now a deterministic latest-effective-date tie-break instead of list-order-dependent.

regression_suite_state_at_freeze._total: 387/387, all green at the frozen commit -- DETERMINISTIC REGRESSION SUITE, not benchmark/blind accuracy

known_remaining_limitations_at_freeze: Taxonomy #17/#22: sparse/subset-word-collision risks in values_match()'s compound-word fallback -- BENCHMARK_ADAPTER_LIMIT_REACHED, disclosed, not fixed further. Confirmed a THIRD real instance during Phase 5 (certificate IDs), reinforcing this is systemic.
PREDICATE_ALIAS category remains unused in the corpus.
'Required approval classes' (dual sign-off) confirmed NOT a real architecture gap -- fully expressible via existing predicate-scoping (LNES59-B8-001).
No B0-B4 baseline or full X0-X1 sweep has been run -- X2 remains the only arm with real empirical data.
